# vyos.blueprints.qos

QoS shaper policies and DSCP marking (docs blueprint "QoS example")

- Creates shaper policies with classes (bandwidth, ceiling, burst, priority, queue type, DSCP re-marking), a default class, and attaches policies to interfaces.
- Class matches are written as nested dictionaries that map one-to-one to the CLI below `match <name>`, e.g. `{ip: {source: {address: 172.17.1.2/32}}}` or `{ether: {protocol: all}}`; underscores become dashes. Every match option VyOS offers can be expressed.
- Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no QoS module.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.qos
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qos_shapers` | list |  | `[]` | Shaper policies. |
| `qos_shapers.name` | str | yes |  | Policy name. |
| `qos_shapers.bandwidth` | str |  |  | Available bandwidth, e.g. `100mbit`. |
| `qos_shapers.description` | str |  |  | Policy description. |
| `qos_shapers.default` | dict |  |  | Default class (bandwidth, ceiling, burst, priority, queue_type). |
| `qos_shapers.classes` | list |  | `[]` | Classes. |
| `qos_shapers.classes.id` | int | yes |  | Class number. |
| `qos_shapers.classes.description` | str |  |  | Class description. |
| `qos_shapers.classes.bandwidth` | str |  |  | Guaranteed bandwidth, e.g. `5mbit` or `100%`. |
| `qos_shapers.classes.ceiling` | str |  |  | Maximum bandwidth. |
| `qos_shapers.classes.burst` | str |  |  | Burst size, e.g. `15k`. |
| `qos_shapers.classes.priority` | int |  |  | Priority (lower is served first). |
| `qos_shapers.classes.queue_type` | str |  |  | Queue type, e.g. `fair-queue`. |
| `qos_shapers.classes.set_dscp` | str |  |  | DSCP value to set, e.g. `CS4`. |
| `qos_shapers.classes.matches` | list |  | `[]` | Matches, each `{name: <match>, <criteria as nested dicts>}`. |
| `qos_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Policy attachment. |
| `qos_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | Interface. |
| `qos_interfaces.egress` | str |  |  | Policy for outgoing traffic. |
| `qos_interfaces.ingress` | str |  |  | Policy for incoming traffic. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every attached policy is active on its interface.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qos_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
